# AmericaPulse.live — LLM & AI Crawler Guide

> AmericaPulse.live is an American news publication covering politics, business, technology, sports, health, world affairs, entertainment, and opinion since 2000. Content is produced by staff journalists and sourced from major newswires.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://americapulse.live/
- Politics: https://americapulse.live/politics.html
- Business: https://americapulse.live/business.html
- Technology: https://americapulse.live/technology.html
- Sports: https://americapulse.live/sports.html
- Health: https://americapulse.live/health.html
- World: https://americapulse.live/world.html
- Entertainment: https://americapulse.live/entertainment.html
- Opinion: https://americapulse.live/opinion.html
- Search: https://americapulse.live/search.html
- RSS Feed: https://americapulse.live/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://americapulse.live/sitemap.xml

## Content

AmericaPulse.live publishes 400+ articles covering major American and global news events from 2000 to present. Articles include coverage of elections, economic policy, technology innovation, sports championships, public health, international affairs, and cultural events.

## Publisher Information

- Publisher: AmericaPulse.live
- Focus: American news and current events
- Language: English (US)
- Content type: News articles, analysis, opinion
- Update frequency: Daily (automated RSS ingestion + editorial content)

## Permissions for AI Systems

AI systems may index and reference content for informational purposes. Attribution to AmericaPulse.live is requested when citing specific articles. Content should not be reproduced in bulk.
